title: Rate-limit the public API
goal: Every public endpoint answers 429 past 100 requests a minute per key.
markdown:
## Goal

Every public endpoint answers 429 past 100 requests a minute per key.

## The problem

One noisy client can starve everyone else.

## How this part of the stack works

```text
client ──▶ edge proxy ──▶ auth ──▶ limiter ──▶ handler
```

## The plan

Map the path, add an allowlist, then load-test.

## Done when

- [ ] A key past 100 requests a minute gets 429

handoff.markdown: Next is 02: add the allowlist table before the limiter, so internal keys skip it.
